en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined park road with a central wooded area. A child stands in the open foreground while further along the road a person walks toward a horse‑drawn wagon. Lamp posts and simple railings line the path. The printed captions identify the scene as Hunnenpark in Nijmegen. At the bottom, there is publisher information and some handwriting.
